modes.title: Mode
modes.winBy2Hint: From {tie}:{tie} the game goes on until someone leads by two, even 90:88.
modes.timedHint: {n} min of play, then the team ahead wins; on a tie the next goal wins. Reaching {target} ends the game earlier.

series.title: Series
series.hint: Teams swap colours after every game.

formatHint.king: Winners stay at the table, losers go to the back of the queue. Wins in a row are counted.
formatHint.dyp: Every game draws who plays and with whom: those who played least first, in pairs that have not played together yet. Individual ranking.
formatHint.roundRobin: Fixed teams, everyone plays everyone once. A table and a list of games to play.
formatHint.cup: Knockout: the loser is out, the winner plays on to the final. It can start with two groups.
formatHint.series: Two teams play best of 3 or 5, swapping colours every game.
formatHint.open: Play as many games as you like, in any lineups of the chosen players. Individual table.
formatHint.rotation: Everyone partners everyone once, with changing opponents. Individual table.
